# Verification status

<!-- generated by tools/release/verification_status.py (D199) from features.toml and results.json; do not edit -->

Every feature a case file can switch on, with its grade, the evidence that checks it and the known gaps. The table of features is [features.toml](features.toml), written by hand and reviewed in pull requests; the grades are computed from it and from the last [verification manual](manual.md) (runs of Foehncraft 0.6.0 (0bd0359bc958), 0.6.0 (77736fa17e07)), never typed in. The same as data: [grades.json](grades.json).

**116 features: 50 verified, 63 partial, 3 unverified.**

## How a grade is computed

Kinds of evidence: `exact` (an exact solution, often with its observed order), `manufactured` (a manufactured solution with its order), `reference-data` (experiments, DNS, published benchmarks and correlations) and `consistency` (conservation, equality of two paths, bitwise equality, input checks) and `contract` (only for infrastructure features: a tested promise such as bitwise restart, a fixed output schema, replay to identical files, equality of command line and Python).

An item *holds* when its test exists (tests run on every pull request), its recorded run is documented, or its case passed in the last manual run or runs in a CI case set.

| Grade | Rule |
|---|---|
| verified | an `exact` or `manufactured` item holds, a `reference-data` item holds where the feature is a model, no gap is written and every case has a run |
| partial | some items hold, but gaps are written, or only `consistency` checks hold, or a model has no reference data, or a case has no run |
| verified (infrastructure) | restart, logs, run record, interfaces: every contract the row lists (`bitwise`, `schema`, `equivalence`, `replay`, `control`, `diagnostics`, `round-trip`) has a holding `contract` item, and no gap is written |
| unverified | no item holds, or a case of the feature failed in the last manual run |

A gap written into the table, or a failing case, lowers the grade at once; raising it needs evidence. *Range* is the validated range of the feature; a run outside it will be reported as a limitation (D199).

<a id="numerics-limiters"></a>

### Venkatakrishnan(-Wang) limiters

**partial** (gaps written) · id `numerics.limiters` · switch `solver.momentum.limiter`

- exact: [`oblique_step_2d`](../../examples/cases/scalar/oblique_step_2d.toml): a discontinuity at 30° stays within its bounds with every limiter (manual: range of the solution (upwind) 0 – 1 (± 1e-6); range of the solution (venkatakrishnan) 0 – 1 (± 1e-6); range of the solution (venkatakrishnan-wang) 0 – 1 (± 1e-6); range of the solution (bounded-central) 0 – 1 (± 1e-6)) ([results](stage2.md#limiters-on-the-oblique-step))
- consistency: [`limited_face_values_create_no_new_extrema`](../../crates/foehncraft-fv/tests/stage2.rs): limited face values create no new extrema

Gaps:

- no observed order with a limiter switched on in a smooth flow

<a id="numerics-mlp-limiter"></a>

### Vertex-based MLP limiter of the scalars and the energy equation

**partial** (gaps written) · id `numerics.mlp-limiter` · switch `solver.scalar.limiter, solver.energy.limiter = "mlp"` · decisions D237

- exact: [`scalar_oblique_step_mlp`](../../examples/cases/flow/scalar_oblique_step_mlp.toml): a step at 31° on 30 % perturbed polyhedra stays within [0, 1.0021] with R3 and c = 0.01 (Venkatakrishnan: [−0.0175, 1.0178]) (passes in CI (set linux-3), not yet in the manual) ([results](../gallery/scalars.md#mlp-limiter))
- exact: [`mlp_limiter_bounds_the_oblique_step`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/scalars.rs): within ε of the bounds with c = 0.01, within 10⁻⁹ with c = 0, the face limiter outside
- consistency: [`nishikawa_functions_are_bounded_and_smooth`](../../crates/foehncraft-kernels/src/fv.rs): R3, R4 and R5 bounded at ε = 0 and smooth
- consistency: [`a_strip_of_two_hexahedra_shares_four_vertices`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/src/limiter.rs): the vertex stencil of a small mesh
- consistency: [`tjunction_mixing`](../../examples/cases/flow/tjunction_mixing.toml): θ of the T-junction within [−0.0019, 1.0015], the scalar difference converges at order 2.1 over three meshes (passes in CI (set linux-1), not yet in the manual) ([results](../gallery/flow.md#tjunction-mixing))
- consistency: [`mlp_limiter_restart_continues_bit_identically`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/scalars.rs): ψ of the relaxation in restart.h5 (`scalar_psi_<name>`): a steady run continued from the middle ends bit-identically
- consistency: [`steady_cht_restart_with_the_mlp_energy_limiter_is_bit_identical`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/cht_cycle.rs): the energy's ψ in restart.h5 (`cht_psi`): a steady conjugate run continued from the middle ends bit-identically

Gaps:

- not the default: Venkatakrishnan stays the limiter of the scalars and the energy equation until a full validation run
- ε = 0 and the per-cell ε can stall a steady run (the T-junction from the medium mesh on)
- on a smooth manufactured solution on polyhedra the error with R3 is 2.5 times the unlimited one (second order kept)
- bounds the reconstruction, not a stalled steady iteration: the water of the heat exchanger (application 203) falls to 15.7 °C in a few end-chamber cells, below its 20 °C inlet
- not run on a GPU

- reference-data: [`pipe_turbulent_sst`](../../examples/cases/flow/pipe_turbulent_sst.toml): pipe at Re_b 5300: u_τ/U_b +4.5 % from the DNS of El Khoury et al. (2013), GCI 0.2 % (band ±6 %) (passes in CI (set linux-1), not yet in the manual)
- consistency: [`diffuser_sst`](../../examples/cases/flow/diffuser_sst.toml): asymmetric diffuser with rounded corners, developed channel-profile inlet: converges on three meshes (6 960 to 111 360 cells); reattachment 28.94 H (GCI 0.36 %), separation 2.20 H (GCI 4 %), C_p(45 H) 0.5465 (GCI below 0.01 %) (passes in CI (set linux-1), not yet in the manual) ([results](../gallery/turbulence.md#diffuser))
- consistency: [`diffuser_sst_sharp`](../../examples/cases/flow/diffuser_sst_sharp.toml): the same diffuser with sharp corners (cells shortened towards the corners), three meshes (8 400 to 134 400 cells): reattachment 29.03 H (GCI 0.51 %), C_p(45 H) 0.5417 (GCI 0.15 %), separation 2.03 H (order 0.6, GCI 9 %) (passes in CI (set linux-2), not yet in the manual) ([results](../gallery/turbulence.md#diffuser))
- consistency: [`diffuser_channel_profile`](../../examples/cases/flow/diffuser_channel_profile.toml): periodic channel at centreline Re 20 000: centreline velocity 1.000 m/s, the developed inlet table of the diffuser (passes in CI (set linux-1), not yet in the manual)
- consistency: [`ubend_sst`](../../examples/cases/flow/ubend_sst.toml): U-bend of Monson et al., Rc/H = 1, Re_b 1e5, developed channel-profile inlet: converges on three meshes (8 832 to 141 312 cells); inner-wall separation 139.8 deg (GCI 0.19 %), reattachment 2.19 H behind the turn (GCI 2.9 %, oscillatory), wall C_p GCI 0.03 to 0.27 % (passes in CI (set linux-1), not yet in the manual) ([results](../gallery/turbulence.md#ubend))
- consistency: [`ubend_sst_sharp`](../../examples/cases/flow/ubend_sst_sharp.toml): the same U-bend with sharp edges (square divider end and end wall): converges on 12 624 and 50 400 cells; separated region behind the divider end closes at 3.05 H and 2.89 H (passes in CI (set linux-2), not yet in the manual) ([results](../gallery/turbulence.md#ubend))
- consistency: [`ubend_channel_profile`](../../examples/cases/flow/ubend_channel_profile.toml): periodic channel at Re_b 1e5: the developed inlet table of the U-bend (passes in CI (set linux-1), not yet in the manual)
- reference-data: [`backstep_outlet_backflow`](../../examples/cases/flow/backstep_outlet_backflow.toml): backward-facing step with the outlet inside the recirculation
- reference-data: recorded run (level sweep of backstep_validation with SST, 3 meshes): step of Driver & Seegmiller (1985): x_r/H 6.747, +7.8 % (band ±10 %) ([results](stage6.md#backward-facing-step-against-the-experiment-part-6g-95))
- consistency: [`sst_results_are_bitwise_equal_on_1_and_4_threads`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/turbulence.rs): bitwise equal on 1 and 4 threads

Gaps:

- asymmetric diffuser (gallery 199): not compared with the measurements of Buice & Eaton (pending); the separation point converges at order 1.6 only (GCI 4 %), and the steady solver needs about three times the iterations per halving of the mesh (4 909 on 111 360 cells) while the jet moves slowly to the upper wall; with sharp corners the finest mesh ends at the 8 000-iteration cap with residuals of 4e-7 and the separation point converges at order 0.6 (GCI 9 %)
- U-bend (gallery 204): not compared with the measurements of Monson et al. (pending, owner choice: GCI first); the Re_b 1e6 case of the experiment not run; the reattachment converges oscillatory (GCI 2.9 %); the sharp-edged variant needs relaxation 0.5 at the start, and its finest mesh (201 600 cells) did not converge in 8 000 iterations (bubble still growing), so its GCI (reattachment 0.85 %, C_p 10 H behind the turn 4.3 %) is provisional

Notes:

- plate C_f against White's correlation −8.5 to −5.4 % (band ±8 %, widened from ±5 % on 2026-11-22): SST sits −6.1 % below White at x = 0.97 and −1.4 to +2.5 % from the Coles–Fernholz fit to measured layers
- plate C_f converges monotonically but slowly (p 0.44, GCI 1.76 %); it meets the 2 % GCI band without the order

Range: y_plus_first 0 … 1.

- manufactured: [`curvature_correction_manufactured_solution_orders`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/src/turbulence/mms.rs): orders 1.9 to 2.1 of k and ω with f_r1 (DS_ij/Dt from a flow whose strain axes turn) on hexahedra and polyhedra ([results](stage6.md#manufactured-solutions-of-k-ε-ζ-f₀-the-curvature-correction-and-the-qcr-pr-184))
- manufactured: [`curvature_correction_on_tetrahedra_converges`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/src/turbulence/mms.rs): order 1.9 to 2.1 of k and ω on regular and 15 % perturbed tetrahedra with S_ij from a second-order velocity gradient and the gradient of S_ij from a quadratic least-squares fit where the least-squares one is not consistent (D236) ([results](stage6.md#consistent-curvature-correction-on-irregular-meshes-d236-pr-197))
- consistency: recorded run (ubend_sst with turbulence.curvature_correction = true, levels 0 and 1): U-bend Rc/H = 1: the bubble on the convex inner wall grows (separation 127.5 deg instead of 139.4 deg, reattachment 2.57 H instead of 2.19 H on level 1) ([results](../gallery/turbulence.md#ubend))

Gaps:

- the DNS of Kristoffersen & Andersson (1993) for the rotating channel is not compared (its data are not in the repository)
- on one-layer 2D meshes the operator check (D236) reports MESH005 on every cell: the quadratic fit of the velocity Hessian is rank deficient in z (U-bend, gallery 204); a false alarm in 2D, not fixed

- manufactured: [`qcr_stress_on_perturbed_meshes_converges`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/src/turbulence/mms.rs): the stress force on 15 % perturbed hexahedra and tetrahedra converges (hexahedra 4.6 %, 1.5 %, 0.65 %; tetrahedra order 1) with the quadratic least-squares gradient and the skewness-corrected face stress (D236) ([results](stage6.md#consistent-qcr-stress-on-irregular-meshes-d236-pr-194))

Gaps:

- the DNS of Pinelli et al. (2010) is not compared within a band (its data are not in the repository)
- the divergence of the explicit QCR stress is first order on tetrahedra, regular or perturbed (the midpoint rule of the face sum on irregular cells), and second order only on regular hexahedra and polyhedra; the coupled momentum equations are not in the manufactured solution

<a id="run-pressure-values"></a>

### Absolute or gauge pressure values, operating pressure per fluid part

**partial** (gaps written) · id `run.pressure-values` · switch `[fluid] pressure_values` · decisions D239

- consistency: [`cht_two_fluids_absolute`](../../examples/cases/flow/cht_two_fluids_absolute.toml): water at 1 bar and oil at 1.5 bar across a steel plate: each part takes its own outlet as its operating pressure, absolute field and boundary values (passes in CI (set linux-3), not yet in the manual) ([results](../gallery/boundary-conditions.md#absolute-pressure))
- contract (bitwise): [`an_absolute_case_and_its_gauge_twin_run_the_same_bits`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/pressure_values.rs): an absolute channel at 1 bar and its gauge twin: the same residual history and mass flows, boundary pressures apart by p_op
- contract (bitwise): [`two_parts_take_their_own_outlet_pressures`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/pressure_values.rs): two fluid parts at 1 and 1.5 bar against the gauge twin with region operating pressures: the same bits
- consistency: [`older_files_keep_meaning_gauge`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/pressure_values.rs): files of format 0.6 and without a format read as gauge values with a note
- consistency: [`a_changed_default_keeps_the_meaning_of_older_files`](../../crates/foehncraft-mesh/src/case_format.rs): the changed default goes into older flow cases only, `foehn case upgrade` writes it
- contract (diagnostics): [`an_absolute_zero_is_refused`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/pressure_values.rs): an absolute 0 Pa is refused with PRS001 and the hint `pressure_values = "gauge"`

Gaps:

- `[output.coefficients] reference_pressure` (an absolute reference of the pressure coefficient) is not built
- the vapour-pressure warning of a liquid is not built (no material has a vapour pressure yet)
- a pressure boundary shared by two fluid parts takes the operating pressure of the first part

Contracts: `bitwise`, `diagnostics`.

<a id="run-start-values"></a>

### Start values per region and per fluid part

**partial** (gaps written) · id `run.start-values` · switch `[regions.<name>.initial]` · decisions D238

- consistency: [`cht_two_fluids_start`](../../examples/cases/flow/cht_two_fluids_start.toml): water and oil at their inlet temperatures, the plate at 320 K, the oil pressure on a Laplace solve between its total-pressure inlet and outlet; 2251 instead of 2616 iterations from a uniform start (passes in CI (set linux-3), not yet in the manual) ([results](../gallery/energy.md#start-values))
- consistency: [`a_part_between_two_pressures_starts_on_the_laplace_solution`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/src/start.rs): a channel between 10 Pa and 0 Pa starts on the exact straight line (1e-9)
- consistency: [`every_region_and_part_starts_on_its_own`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/start_values.rs): two parts at their own outlet pressures, inlet temperatures per region, REG010 and `start_values`

Contracts: `diagnostics`.

<a id="run-ledger"></a>

### Conservation ledger as data: module rows, thermal account, ledger in result.json

**partial** (gaps written) · id `run.ledger` · switch `result.json solves[].balance.last.ledger, pairs` · decisions D119, D244

- consistency: [`cavity_heated`](../../examples/cases/flow/cavity_heated.toml): the heated cavity: mass and thermal energy close to round-off, the kinetic-energy account shows the numerical dissipation (passes in CI (set linux-3), not yet in the manual) ([results](../gallery/energy.md#ledger))
- contract (schema): [`the_thermal_account_is_the_heat_balance_as_data`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/tests/energy.rs): result.json has mass, kinetic energy and thermal energy accounts with terms; the thermal closure is the negative of the heat-balance imbalance
- contract (schema): [`a_state_without_modules_has_two_accounts_and_no_pairs`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/src/balance.rs): a state without modules has the two accounts and no pairs key
- consistency: [`a_closed_box_with_a_spray_closes_every_step_and_the_run`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/src/balance.rs): a closed box with a stand-in spray module: gas mass, momentum and heat gain what the parcels lose; every account closes to 1e-12 in every step and over the run, every pair cancels to the bit
- consistency: [`a_missing_partner_shows_in_the_pair_residual`](../../crates/foehncraft-flow/src/balance.rs): a pair without its partner shows its value as residual

Gaps:

- the gas momentum account of the solver itself is not booked (it comes with the first exchange rows of the sprays, SP2)
- the viscous heating is not yet an exchange pair kinetic to thermal (the two sums are formed separately)
- the thermal account is in the last balance only, not over a run

Contracts: `schema`.

## Sprays

<a id="sprays-one-way"></a>

### Lagrangian spray parcels, one way (L12, SP1)

**partial** (a model without reference data; gaps written) · id `sprays.one-way` · switch `[spray] include = "..."` · decisions D240, D245, D246

- contract (diagnostics): [`spray_duct`](../../examples/cases/flow/spray_duct.toml): water droplets of 150 µm in an air duct: the mass book injected = in the flow + stuck + left + lost closes to round-off (the run stops with SPR005 otherwise); 71 % of the liquid sticks on the lower wall (passes in CI (set linux-3), not yet in the manual) ([results](../cases/flow.md#lagrangian-sprays))
- contract (schema): [`spray_duct_injectors`](../../examples/cases/flow/spray_duct_injectors.toml): the included injector and liquid file of spray_duct ([results](../cases/flow.md#lagrangian-sprays)) **missing**
- exact: [`stokes_relaxation_and_terminal_velocity`](../../crates/foehncraft-kernels/src/particle.rs): Stokes relaxation and terminal velocity of the exact exponential step to 10⁻⁹
- consistency: [`parcel_follows_the_reference_integration`](../../crates/foehncraft-particles/tests/tracking.rs): trajectories on hexahedral, tetrahedral, polyhedral and mixed meshes against a fourth-order reference integration
- exact: [`mass_books_close_and_parcels_stay_in_their_cells`](../../crates/foehncraft-particles/tests/tracking.rs): mass books for stick, rebound and escape; every parcel is in its cell
- exact: [`threads_do_not_change_a_bit`](../../crates/foehncraft-particles/tests/tracking.rs): bitwise equal results on 1, 2 and 4 threads
- exact: [`restart_state_continues_bitwise`](../../crates/foehncraft-particles/tests/tracking.rs): a restart continues the parcels bit for bit

Gaps:

- no reference-data case (terminal velocity in the Schiller-Naumann range, a prescribed vortex, grid turbulence)
- the gas does not feel the droplets (two-way coupling is SP2); no turbulent dispersion, evaporation or breakup
- the gas state is sampled at the start of each sub-step (first order in the gas); the time of a wall hit is a chord fraction
- one process; no rotating zones or periodic boundaries (SPR003)
- the CPU = GPU check of the parcel kernel runs in the PTX job of CI only
- `spray_duct_injectors` has no run in the verification manual or in CI
